analyst_view.overall: Tenerife (13th, 18 points, a game in hand) host Mallorca (7th, one point off the play-offs) in the second home game since the death of former player Jesús de Miguel, whom Mallorca honoured at the stadium on Friday. Both sides are tired: Tenerife play their third game in six days after beating Ceuta and winning 2-5 at Badajoz in the cup, and Álvaro Cervera has called fitness a main worry; Mallorca needed extra time to beat Alcoyano in the cup and had two days to recover. Mallorca are without Morlanes, Antoniu Roca, David López, Antonio Sánchez and others (the listed ones are in the numbers), with Alberto Moreno and Puigmal doubts, while Raíllo, Valjent, Cerdà, Dani Luna and the returning internationals are available. Mallorca are in their worst spell (five games without a clean sheet) and their sporting director was dismissed this week; referee Juan Gordillo Escamilla shows many cards and the numbers already add for him.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.1 goals. Two points pull in opposite directions: Cervera's Tenerife defend deep and concede little and both teams are tired, but Mallorca have gone five games without a clean sheet and Enric Gallego is a constant threat. The numbers already count both sides' recent scoring, so I stay at 2.1.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.9 corners and already add for Mallorca's 43 corners in their last six. Tenerife sitting deep and breaking could feed Mallorca corners, but that is the pattern the numbers already see, so I stay at 8.9.

cards.text: The numbers say 6.6 cards, already raised a lot for referee Juan Gordillo Escamilla (7.8 a game in 6 games) and for both sides' recent cards. Tired legs late in the game can bring fouls, but the atmosphere around the De Miguel tribute has been one of respect between the clubs, so I add nothing and stay at 6.6.

shots.text: The numbers say 22.4 shots. I lean slightly lower to about 21.5 because Tenerife play their third game in six days and Mallorca had only two days after an extra-time cup tie, which the numbers can't see, and Cervera's side limits chances at home.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 6.7 shots on target. For the same fatigue reasons and Tenerife's tight defending, I trim it a little to about 6.5.
